system.description: The dwarf has chosen to indulge in the mountain’s ancient power and the holy Thuuldom, and can learn to create rune-inscribed objects through which to activate the mountain’s forces. By obtaining the Holy Tablet (Thuuldom) specialty , the dimwalker can activate the runes found in the learned Holy Tablet. The specialty gives +2 in Skill Value per level for creating items and runes and inserting Divinity Points in the runes.
system.summary: Dedicates the dwarf to the ancient powers of Thuuldom: engraving runes that draw on the mountain’s strength.
